proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Rana pʌtːʌɾ “stone” (f_hq6lsm6f7bake). Family evidence: CDIAL 8857 prastara explicitly gives Prakrit patthara and regional pathar/pathara “stone”, including known cross-IA loans. Unaspirated patar remains a qualified phonetic variant within this identifiable stone family. Reviewed comparison: Rana pʌtʰʌɾ “stone” (f_mokwly5lmkipg). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
